mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over two consecutive quarters signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of quarters when FEDFUNDS > 2% for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a significant contraction in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of quarters where GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which raises wage inflation and input costs, eroding corporate margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 5-day forward returns in more than 70% of instances where UNRATE > 6.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in INDPRO and HOUST by more than 1% month-over-month indicates weakening industrial production and housing demand, which reduces corporate earnings and capital expenditures, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of months when both INDPRO and HOUST decline by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% signals a surge in consumer savings, which typically precedes a reduction in consumption and lower corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in FEDFUNDS and a fall in CPIAUCSL by more than 0.5% month-over-month indicates aggressive monetary tightening accompanied by deflationary pressure, which increases risk aversion and depresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of months when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for three consecutive months signals weakening employment, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS < 12-month moving average -2% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves positive 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of episodes where PAYEMS is below its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in GDPC1 above its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive quarters signals a robust demand expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > 12-month moving average +3% for four consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 achieves negative 60-day forward returns in more than 60% of periods where GDPC1 exceeds its 12-month moving average by more than 3% for four consecutive quarters.
